Are you doing the dumbbell floor press the right way? Most people make small mistakes that limit chest, triceps, and shoulder activation. In this video, I show you how to properly set up and perform the dumbbell floor press for maximum strength gains and safety.

I’ll walk you through:
✅ The proper dumbbell placement and setup
✅ How to control the press for maximum muscle activation
✅ Key foot and back positions that prevent injury
✅ Tips to drive your dumbbells safely from the floor to the top

Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced lifter, these tips will help you get stronger, build muscle, and lift smarter. Don’t skip the setup—floor pressing incorrectly can hurt your shoulders and limit gains!
